hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *src/*|*worker/*|*scripts/*) out=$(npm run check:fast 2>&1) || { { echo "Checks FAILED after editing $f"; echo "$out" | grep -E '^FAIL|error TS' | head -12; } >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
hooks.rewakeMessage: A check failed after your last edit. These are the gates that exist because this exact class of bug shipped before — fix it before moving on:
